correction.cause: cat-file input used insertion order; the consumer used sorted(bysha.items()). Returned object IDs were not checked. Contents were assigned to unrelated paths.
correction.replacement_method: Read actual current files individually by path. Bind the same bytes to SHA-256 and parsed JSON fields. No cat-file batch.

scope.reads: Only current regular files in the enumerated union. No recursive directory scan, ignored contents, symlink traversal or private backup reads.
scope.inventory_digest_format: UTF-8 sorted path + NUL + decimal byte count + NUL + SHA256, joined with LF, no final LF

email_redaction.note: Old reference read one path at a time. 56 original hashes match parked Git bytes exactly; 9 match CRLF checkout bytes. Old/new parsed JSON differs only at declared email fields. Private publication-hold originals were not opened.

pattern_checks.limits: Pattern probes do not guarantee absence of every secret. Public IDs, project paths, timestamps and license attributions are not treated as credentials.

historical_separation.baseline_ui_history_note: Ten UI JSON paths exist in the public baseline. Working-tree deletion does not erase historical blobs. Not newly introduced by this migration.

preserved_staging_tools.policy: Retain as historical source helpers, not generated artifacts. Historical project/toolchain paths are not credentials. Do not execute locally; future execution requires approved workflow and path review.
